metadata.title: TSMC Is Raising Prices. Can Big Tech’s AI Boom Afford the Bill?<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
TSMC Is Raising Prices. Can Big Tech’s AI Boom Afford the Bill?
Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing intends to raise its prices by up to 10% from 2027, Nikkei Asia reported Tuesday, citing unnamed sources.
